title: Generalized Structural Trigger and Computational Growth Intelligence
description: Generalized Structural Trigger and Computational Growth Intelligence (GST-CGI) presents a structural-intelligence framework that extends Two-Way CCC beyond String-DNA-only trigger representations toward generalized structural triggers with explicit structural state, comparison semantics, controlled behavior, evidence APIs, and policy perspectives. The framework introduces the Leaf Resolution Gate with DECIDE, REFINE, LEFTOVER, and DELEGATE outcomes; treats Leftover as a first-class structural boundary and a source for Delta Intelligence; introduces the Leaf Sandbox Package and Delegated Structural Unfolding for policy-bounded external computation; and defines Computational Growth Intelligence as the capability to construct, refine, validate, delegate, compose, and govern the computational structures through which future intelligence is performed. GST-CGI distinguishes Experience Growth, Performance Growth, Computational-Structure Growth, and Computational-System Growth, and extends these mechanisms toward policy-governed AI-to-AI structural computation, structural collective learning, AI Computational CallingGraphs, and AI computational ecosystems.
